_comment: Accessories catalogue. Each entry lists the product family slugs it is used with in `for`. Product pages read this file to show 'Accessories used with this product' and feed the enquiry list.

accessories.name: Sliding Rail Kit — 28"
accessories.description: Tool-less sliding rails for 19" EIA-310 racks, 24" – 32" post depth. One kit per chassis.

accessories.name: Short-Depth Rail Kit — 20"
accessories.description: Fixed rails for short-depth industrial racks and wall cabinets.

accessories.name: 3.5" Hot-Swap Drive Carrier
accessories.description: Spare tool-less carrier for 3.5" SAS / SATA drives. Keep two per site as cold spares.

accessories.name: 2.5" Hot-Swap Drive Carrier
accessories.description: Spare tool-less carrier for 2.5" NVMe / SAS / SATA media.

accessories.name: Enterprise HDD — 16 TB SAS
accessories.description: 16 TB 7200 rpm enterprise SAS drive, burn-in tested and firmware-matched to the array.

accessories.name: Enterprise HDD — 20 TB SAS
accessories.description: 20 TB 7200 rpm enterprise SAS drive for capacity expansion a bay at a time.

accessories.name: NVMe Cache Kit — 2 × 1.6 TB U.2
accessories.description: Mirrored U.2 NVMe pair for the read/write cache tier ahead of the HDD pool.

accessories.name: Redundant PSU Module — 800 W
accessories.description: Hot-swap 800 W CRPS module, 80 PLUS Platinum. Field-replaceable without downtime.

accessories.name: Redundant PSU Module — 1600 W
accessories.description: Hot-swap 1600 W CRPS module for high-TDP and storage-dense builds.

accessories.name: Hot-Swap Fan Module
accessories.description: 8038 PWM hot-swap fan module. Swaps from the top without opening the airflow path.

accessories.name: Dual-Port 10GbE NIC
accessories.description: Dual SFP+ 10GbE adapter for the archive and reading-room uplinks.

accessories.name: Dual-Port 25GbE NIC
accessories.description: Dual SFP28 25GbE adapter for high-throughput ingest and AI training pulls.

accessories.name: RAID Controller Battery Backup
accessories.description: Supercap backup for the battery-backed RAID cache. Replace every 3 – 5 years.

accessories.name: SAS Expansion Cable — 2 m
accessories.description: SFF-8644 to SFF-8644 cable for daisy-chaining Io pods to a Jupiter head.

accessories.name: Memory Kit — 64 GB DDR5 RDIMM
accessories.description: ECC RDIMM kit, validated against the Mercury and Jupiter memory maps.

accessories.name: Memory Kit — 32 GB DDR5 SODIMM
accessories.description: SODIMM kit for the small-form-factor and edge platforms.

accessories.name: Workstation GPU — 16 GB
accessories.description: Full-height workstation GPU for 3D, MPR and reconstruction workloads.

accessories.name: Diagnostic Display — 5 MP Greyscale
accessories.description: 5 MP 10-bit greyscale panel with calibration sensor, DICOM GSDF tracked.

accessories.name: VESA Mounting Bracket
accessories.description: 100 × 100 VESA bracket to hang the unit behind a display or under a counter.

accessories.name: DIN Rail Mounting Kit
accessories.description: DIN rail clip set for cabinet installation next to the modality.

accessories.name: Wide-Range DC Power Adapter
accessories.description: 9 – 36 V DC adapter with locking connector for edge and cart installations.

accessories.name: Wi-Fi / LTE Expansion Module
accessories.description: M.2 wireless module with external antenna kit for mobile imaging units.

accessories.name: Intake Dust Filter Kit
accessories.description: Washable intake filters for industrial and plant-floor installations. Pack of 3.

accessories.name: Locking Front Door
accessories.description: Keyed locking front door to stop drive and media removal on open sites.
